svg.title: Atmospheric Minimalism — complete independent direction
svg.desc: Original Atmospheric Minimalism concept for ACTOR Agents Arena. Fictional UI copy. Vector mockup, not a Unity screenshot.

g.text: Independent whole-game direction · Original editable vector studies · 800 × 600 screen layouts
Share what you observed. Claims belong to their speaker.
I found Vale in the east corridor.
I did not see who was there before.
I passed Storage. Did anyone see
I was in Engineering. That is all
Select, then confirm. Your final ballot cannot be changed.
Only eligible living participants can vote.
Face aperture and colour remain identifiable.
Body art is never a rotated idle.
Foot pivot fixed. Preserve phase on a turn.
Only visual pose moves; physics root stays put.
No gore · One quiet impact · No camera shake by default · Reduced motion keeps the same authoritative outcome
A quiet station that makes people conspicuous
Noto Sans proposed for Latin + Cyrillic. Mockups use system sans.
No font binary bundled; glyph and licence QA precede integration.
You can return to your own actor.
Dry felt steps. Muted ceramic impacts.
Three soft tones for a phase transition.
No off-screen event sound or role cue.
Reduced motion: opacity only, no shake.
Sprite atlases + existing motor / UI Toolkit candidate / tinted panels work without blur / no runtime SVG dependency
Concept renders only. No Unity integration, rendered gameplay, platform performance or interaction acceptance is claimed.
